/*
 * NEGATIVE CONTROL FIXTURE for c2s-rescue/scripts/check-c2s-paint-paths.py.
 *
 * A minimal reproduction of the setup_arch() statement order in
 * arch/arm64/kernel/setup.c, with the defect this candidate has to catch
 * put in: milestone S2 painted between cpu_uninstall_idmap() and
 * paging_init().  In that window TTBR0 already points at reserved_pg_dir
 * (no identity mapping) while map_mem() has not run yet (no linear
 * mapping), so c2s_band_early() would fault instead of painting - and on
 * a device a fault there is indistinguishable from "the kernel died in
 * setup_arch()".
 *
 * Every statement the gate looks for is present exactly once; only the
 * placement of c2s_band_early(2624, ...) is wrong.  The gate must REJECT
 * this file.
 */
void setup_arch_marker_order(void)
{
	setup_machine_fdt(__fdt_pointer);
	c2s_band_early(2496, 0xff008080);

	cpu_uninstall_idmap();
	c2s_mark_idmap_gone();

	arm64_memblock_init();

	c2s_band_early(2624, 0xff800080);

	paging_init();
	c2s_mark_linear_ready();

	c2s_band_early(2752, 0xffc0c0c0);
}
